description: What usually needs doing after a death, in five stages (the first 24 hours, the first few days, planning the service, the day itself, after the service), with short notes for the United States, United Kingdom, Canada or Australia and links to official government pages. General guidance only, not legal advice: the funeral director or local office knows the local rules. Offer it gently, a stage at a time if that's easier.

country.description: Adds that country's notes and official links: US, GB or UK (United Kingdom), CA, AU.

stage.description: Only one stage: first-day (the first 24 hours), first-days (the first few days), planning (planning the service), the-day (the day itself), after (after the service).

name: funeral_planning_checklist
title: Funeral planning checklist
